gsm.ctas cookbook

Cookbook.Rmd

Installation 

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("IMPALA-Consortium/gsm.ctas")

Load 

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
library(workr)
library(gsm.mapping)
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.ctas)

Raw data

gsm.ctas ships SDTM domains (dm, lb, vs, eg, rs) and a synthetic ctasapp queries frame.

lRaw <- list(
  Raw_DM = gsm.ctas::dm,
  Raw_LB = gsm.ctas::lb,
  Raw_VS = gsm.ctas::vs,
  Raw_EG = gsm.ctas::eg,
  Raw_RS = gsm.ctas::rs,
  Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries,
  Raw_PD = gsm.ctas::pd
)

str(lRaw, max.level = 1)
#> List of 7
#>  $ Raw_DM     : tibble [306 × 28] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>   ..- attr(*, "label")= chr "Demographics"
#>  $ Raw_LB     : tibble [59,580 × 23] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>   ..- attr(*, "label")= chr "Laboratory Test Results"
#>  $ Raw_VS     : tibble [29,643 × 24] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>   ..- attr(*, "label")= chr "Vital Signs"
#>  $ Raw_EG     : tibble [26,717 × 23] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>   ..- attr(*, "label")= chr "Electrocardiogram"
#>  $ Raw_RS     : tibble [5,808 × 19] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)
#>   ..- attr(*, "label")= chr "Disease Response and Clin Classification"

Mapping 

lMappingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = NULL,
  strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.ctas"),
  strPackage = NULL
)

lIngest <- gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows))

lMapped <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  workr::RunWorkflows(lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows, lData = lIngest)
))

names(lMapped)
#>  [1] "Mapped_DM"       "Mapped_EG"       "Mapped_LB"       "Mapped_RS"      
#>  [5] "Mapped_VS"       "Mapped_BMI"      "Mapped_SITE"     "Mapped_STUDY"   
#>  [9] "Mapped_Subjects" "Mapped_PD"       "Mapped_Queries"

Standardize_Domain()

Rename an SDTM domain into the CTAS long vocabulary. Default output is numeric-ready (parameter_category_3 = "numeric").

dfVS <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = lMapped$Mapped_VS,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "VSTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "VSTEST",
  strValueCol = "VSSTRESN",
  strCategory = "Vital Signs"
)

dfVS

Transform_Range()

Rescale each result into its reference range ((x - low) / (high - low)). Fields where most values lack a usable range (e.g. ANISO) are kept as raw NUM_ values; rows with a missing value or range keep result = NA.

dfLBraw <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = lMapped$Mapped_LB,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "LBTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "LBTEST",
  strValueCol = "LBSTRESN",
  strLowCol = "LBSTNRLO",
  strHighCol = "LBSTNRHI",
  strCharCol = "LBSTRESC",
  strCategory = "Labs"
)

dfRange <- Transform_Range(dfLBraw)
#> `Transform_Range()`: 1 field is 100% missing for all subjects: "COLOR".
#> `Transform_Range()` kept 7 fields as raw "numeric" because most values lack a
#> usable reference range: "ANISO", "KETONES", "UROBIL", "MACROCY", "POLYCHR",
#> "POIKILO", and "MICROCY".

Transform_Missing()

Recode each observation as a 0/1 indicator of missingness for missingness-over-time monitoring.

dfMissing <- Transform_Missing(dfLBraw)
#> `Transform_Missing()`: 1 field is 100% missing for all subjects:

Transform_OneHot()

Expand a categorical variable into one binary CTAS timeseries per level.

dfRSraw <- Standardize_Domain(
  dfDomain = gsm.ctas::rs %>% filter(RSTESTCD == "OVRLRESP"),
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  strTestCDCol = "RSTESTCD",
  strTestCol = "RSTEST",
  strValueCol = "RSSTRESC",
  strCategory = "Disease Response"
)

dfOneHot <- Transform_OneHot(dfRSraw)

unique(dfOneHot$parameter_id)
#> [1] "CAT_OVRLRESP=CHECK" "CAT_OVRLRESP=CR"    "CAT_OVRLRESP=PD"   
#> [4] "CAT_OVRLRESP=PR"    "CAT_OVRLRESP=SD"

Standardize_Queries()

Translate the ctasapp query upload schema into the CTAS long vocabulary and fan raw field ids out onto every transformed CTAS parameter id.

dfInputSample <- Transform_Range(dfLBraw)
#> `Transform_Range()`: 1 field is 100% missing for all subjects: "COLOR".
#> `Transform_Range()` kept 7 fields as raw "numeric" because most values lack a
#> usable reference range: "ANISO", "KETONES", "UROBIL", "MACROCY", "POLYCHR",
#> "POIKILO", and "MICROCY".

dfQ <- Standardize_Queries(
  dfQueries = lMapped$Mapped_Queries,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects,
  dfInput = dfInputSample
)

dfQ

Analyze_CTAS()

Score one long-format CTAS frame. Returns one row per site × timeseries × feature.

dfScored <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  Analyze_CTAS(dfVS)
))

dfScored
#> # A tibble: 476 × 15
#>    timeseries_id         site  country region feature pvalue_kstest_logp
#>    <chr>                 <chr> <chr>   <chr>  <chr>                <dbl>

#>  2 ts_1_autogen_original 702   USA     no     sd                 0.00812

#> #   parameter_category_1 <chr>, parameter_category_2 <chr>,
#> #   parameter_category_3 <chr>

Multi-study is honoured automatically when Mapped_Subjects carries several studyid values; results are stacked with a study column.

Metrics workflow 

lMetricWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(
  strNames = NULL,
  strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.ctas"),
  strPackage = NULL
)

lAnalysis <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
  workr::RunWorkflows(lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows, lData = lMapped)
))

names(lAnalysis)
#> [1] "Analysis_categorical"      "Analysis_numeric"         
#> [3] "Analysis_range_normalized" "Analysis_ratio_missing"

BindResults_CTAS()

Concatenate one named frame ("results", "input", "untransformed") across every metric workflow output.

dfResultsLong <- BindResults_CTAS(lAnalysis, "results")

dfResultsLong
#> # A tibble: 15,028 × 15
#>    timeseries_id         site  country region feature pvalue_kstest_logp

Summarize_CTAS() + Flag_CTAS()

Aggregate to the gsm dfResults contract, then flag with left-closed intervals on -log10(p).

dfSummary <- Summarize_CTAS(
  dfResults = dfResultsLong,
  dfSubjects = lMapped$Mapped_Subjects
)

dfSummary

MakeMetric_CTAS()

Emit the family-granular audit table (ctas_<pc3>_<pc2>), one row per field × metric family, with every CTAS parameter column from the metric YAMLs.

dfInputBound <- BindResults_CTAS(lAnalysis, "input")

dfMetricsAudit <- MakeMetric_CTAS(
  dfResults = dfResultsLong,
  lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,
  dfInput = dfInputBound
)

Full workflow

The mapping + metrics + reporting workflow layers chain end-to-end. The shared script is packaged so the cookbook and the Site CTAS Report example stay in sync.

# End-to-end gsm.ctas pipeline shared by the cookbook and the pkgdown example.
# Runs mapping + metrics + reporting workflows against the bundled SDTM
# datasets and stops at `lReporting$Reporting_Summary`.

library(workr)
library(gsm.mapping)
library(gsm.ctas)

lRaw <- list(
  Raw_DM      = gsm.ctas::dm,
  Raw_LB      = gsm.ctas::lb,
  Raw_VS      = gsm.ctas::vs,
  Raw_EG      = gsm.ctas::eg,
  Raw_RS      = gsm.ctas::rs,
  Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries,
  Raw_PD      = gsm.ctas::pd
)

lMappingWorkflows   <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings",  package = "gsm.ctas"))
lMetricWorkflows    <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics",   package = "gsm.ctas"))
lReportingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/3_reporting", package = "gsm.ctas"))

lMapped <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows,
  lData = gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows))
)))

lAnalysis <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,
  lData = lMapped
)))

lReporting <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lReportingWorkflows,
  lData = c(lMapped, list(
    lAnalyzed = lAnalysis,
    lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows
  ))
)))
names(lReporting)
#> [1] "Reporting_Groups"  "Reporting_Results" "Reporting_Metrics"
#> [4] "Reporting_PD"      "Reporting_Queries" "Reporting_Summary"

ctasapp

ctasapp only consumes the results, input, untransformed, queries, pd and metrics frames – the 3_reporting outputs Reporting_Results, Reporting_Queries, Reporting_PD and Reporting_Metrics. The Summary and Groups frames and the 4_modules html render are not needed. Filter the reporting layer with strNames to skip the site-report-only workflows:

Write_ctasapp(lReporting, strDir = "pub", strFormat = "parquet")

Point ctasapp at the parquet folder by editing its embedded: block:

remotes::install_github("IMPALA-Consortium/ctasapp")
file.copy(system.file("ctasapp.yml", package = "ctasapp"), "ctasapp.yml")
# embedded:
#   results: pub/results.parquet
#   input: pub/input.parquet
#   untransformed: pub/untransformed.parquet
#   queries: pub/queries.parquet
#   pd: pub/pd.parquet
#   metrics: pub/metrics.parquet
ctasapp::run_ctas_app()

html Report 

lModuleFlows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/4_modules", package = "gsm.ctas"))

workr::RunWorkflows(
  lWorkflows = lModuleFlows,
  lData = lReporting
)
